properties.description:
Deferred idea, outside the first iteration of decentralized persistence and Git versioning. Explore deterministic commit-time processing through Git hooks so commits made through external tools can apply the same consistency rules as Broccoli. Committing must not require a Broccoli instance to be running. Consider automatic removal of relations targeting a deleted resource within the commit; deleting a relation must not automatically delete the referenced resource. Operate on the commit contents without including unrelated worktree changes. Graph inspection and error/warning reporting remain complementary, and Broccoli retains its user-friendly consistency handling for operations performed through it.
